scenes.say: Where did Earth's water come from?

scenes.title: A likely story
scenes.say: Scientists think icy space rocks and volcanic steam added water, which rained down as Earth cooled.

scenes.label: of Earth's surface is water
scenes.sub: Most of it is salty ocean
scenes.say: Today, about seventy-one percent of Earth's surface is water.
Every drop is billions of years old.
